failure_interpretation: A timeout is a censored search cost. A failed partial-pin cell does not prove the chosen target preimage has no relation because Q1491 already verified one.
input_law: Oracle-assisted partial pins on one known-representable ordinary public target; not natural-query yield.
measurement_scope: Search-localization diagnostic only; not unpinned PDP work, N83 ordinary success, natural yield, or a complete N131 projection.
method: Append only the listed Q1490-derived target selector and midpoint unit clauses to Q1482's byte-identical ordinary N53 CNF. Leave all four leaf x coordinates unpinned in every cell. Use Q1482's frozen native solver binary and compare each outcome with the Q1482 unpinned ordinary receipt and Q1491 fully pinned witness control.
success_gate: Any SAT model must satisfy the modified CNF and independently verify a four-distinct-column public relation. Each cell keeps timeout, UNSAT, invalid-model, and zero-yield outcomes.
